notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content: Removed the starting trap (in front of the machine) to make the start smoother and reduce the number of potential blockages as the player progresses.

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content: - Added objects in the final room to make it easier to access with loops

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Patch

 Fixed tokens that were incorrectly saved in the inventory
 Fixed the double appearance of the starting bag after restarting the game after passing it through the crate
 Fixed green items that were destroyed in a white bag on the ground or in the inventory
 Fixed the bug that prevented the elevator from giving tokens more than once
 Fixed traps that reappeared functional after being used
 When restarting the game, the loading time has been shortened
 Token batches have been removed and replaced with individual tokens


If you find a bug, please report it in the discussions or by email.
